questions.text: State the range of unsigned 8-bit integers.
questions.explanation: Eight bits encode 256 values, from 0 to 255.

questions.text: Explain why hexadecimal is useful for representing binary data.

answer.text: Each hex digit represents four bits, making long binary values shorter and easier to read.

questions.explanation: Four bits correspond to one hexadecimal digit.
